title: Borage - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Edible Wildflower
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious & Bee-Friendly Borage!


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant blue, edible flowers with a cucumber flavour
• Attracts beneficial pollinators, especially bees
• Easy to grow and maintain, even for beginners
• Self-seeds readily for continuous growth
• Organically grown mini plug plants for a healthy start


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Herbs — Borago officinalis
Colour: Sky blue (sometimes white cultivars exist)
Season: Summer (June - October)
Growth Habit: Upright, somewhat sprawling annual herb
Flavour: Delicate cucumber-like fragrance and taste
Time to Harvest: Approx. 8-10 weeks from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun to partial sun
Soil: Well-drained soil (acidic, neutral, alkaline)
Watering: Keep soil moist during establishment; mature plants tolerate drier conditions but prefer consistent moisture.
Spacing: 50cm (20 inches)
Height: 50-70cm (20-28 inches)
Spread: 20-45cm (9-18 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zones 2-11 (grown as an annual in the UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in spring after the last frost, in a sunny spot with well-drained soil.
• Water regularly, especially during dry spells, to encourage larger plants.
• Borage is not a hungry plant, but a general fertiliser in spring can boost growth in poor soils.
• Space plants about 50cm apart to allow for good air circulation and growth.
• Harvest leaves and flowers as needed throughout the summer for culinary use.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
